Dear Konrad Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Associate Data Analyst position in Toronto. I am studying Information Systems in the University of Toronto's Bachelor of Information program, with an expected graduation in June 2027, and currently work as a Business Intelligence Analyst Co-op at Vale. Konrad's combination of analytics, digital product development and consulting appeals to me because I enjoy understanding a business problem, translating it into clear requirements and building tools that help people act on data.

At Vale, I built three Power BI solutions combining SAP and Excel data for leadership and more than 20 users. I also automated five daily processes using VBA, SAP scripting and Power Automate, reducing manual processing time by up to 60% across four teams. This work has taught me to connect reporting needs with practical workflows and communicate technical details in terms that business users can use. In a separate requirements initiative, I interviewed six Sales Managers and identified more than ten workflow issues to inform Dynamics 365 CRM requirements.

Outside work, I built an Instacart recommendation prototype using Python and SQL, comparing five approaches and achieving 24% recall@5 using data from more than 131,000 shoppers. I also have Tableau experience through university coursework. My UX internship and research projects have strengthened how I ask questions, test assumptions and explain findings, skills I would bring to both client conversations and analytical work.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my experience in dashboards, process improvement and requirements gathering while developing my consulting skills with Konrad's Digital team. Thank you for considering my application.
